Comply could bog down rescue if the ranger’s signal stays garbled, wasting precious seconds chasing clarity. It also risks revealing Emily’s identity and location to anyone intercepting the call, giving the killer more leverage. So, which angle are you leaning towards? 🤔

Informing could openly broadcast your location and identity to the killer, making you easier targets. It also risks garbled radio communication or misinterpretation by the ranger, potentially delaying rescue until dawn. So, which angle are you leaning towards? 🤔

Option B (Supportive) could placate Emily too much, slowing or delaying necessary action in a high-stakes moment. It might also curb her willingness to push back or voice warnings, leaving you less prepared for sudden danger. So, which angle are you leaning towards? 🤔

Option B (Demanding) could push Emily into defensiveness, eroding trust when you need cooperation on the tower. It risks Emily withholding information or pushing back, which could hinder progress and decision-making under pressure. So, which angle are you leaning towards? 🤔

It may normalize compliance and make resisting later threats harder, prolonging danger. So, which angle are you leaning towards? 🤔

Option B (Sympathetic) could delay decisive action by letting Emily vent and linger, which might worsen the immediate danger. It could also undermine Matt’s perceived leadership in the moment if he’s seen as overly soft. So, which angle are you leaning towards? 🤔
Here are the two options available: (A) Reluctant and (B) Courageous. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Going to basement

Option B (Courageous) could slam you into the Psycho’s lair with little warning, raising the odds of a lethal encounter or being overpowered. It also commits you to a dangerous path where missteps are punished quickly, and you might miss safer clues or escapes by rushing ahead. So, which angle are you leaning towards? 🤔
